subject: general
question: In economics, ________ involves the creation of goods and services by using resources.
solution:
The correct answer is** production.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Production involves the creation of goods and services by using resources:**

 
 
• Production is the process of combining various material inputs and immaterial inputs (plans, know-how) in order to make something for consumption (the output).
 
• In a financial enterprise, production can involve the creation of financial products such as loans, investment vehicles, and insurance policies.
 
• Resources in production include labor, capital, and raw materials. Efficient use of these resources is critical for maximizing output and profitability.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Exchange:**

 
 
• Exchange refers to the act of trading goods and services between parties. It is a critical component of economics but does not involve the creation of goods and services.
 
 
 
• **Consumption:**
 
 
• Consumption is the use of goods and services by households. It is the end process of economic activity but does not involve the creation of goods and services.
 
 
 
• **Distribution:**
 
 
• Distribution involves the delivery of the produced goods and services to various points of sale or direct to consumers. It is a logistical function and does not involve the creation of goods and services.
